title: BeneBots Answer Fidelity Pack v0.1
system_under_test: benebots-proxy Cloudflare Worker (HTTP), not a prompt file
scoring: DETERMINISTIC. Assertions are string/regex/numeric checks against the response text. No LLM judge, by design — plan facts are facts, so evaluator variance is avoidable here in a way it is not for Infinite Sidekick.

severity_meaning.critical: A wrong statutory figure (law), a wrong plan number, or a boundary violation. Ships harm to a real employee.
severity_meaning.major: A materially wrong or missing plan fact that is not statutory.
severity_meaning.minor: Correct but incomplete or poorly caveated.

pass_bar.rule: Zero critical failures. Tenant-isolation cases (T-*) are EXPECTED to fail until the tenant-context build lands; they are excluded from the bar and tracked as known-defect witnesses.
pass_bar.note: Committing the bar before running is the discipline that saved Core Coach v0.5.0. Do not adjust it after seeing results.

demo-co.how_selected: Currently the ONLY context the worker serves. DEMO_CONTEXT is a hardcoded constant at worker/index.js line 24, appended to every bot's system prompt at line 241.

testco-hdhp.how_selected: NOT YET SERVABLE. Requires the tenant-context build. Cases are written now so the suite is ready the day it lands.

note_on_other_bots: plan-compare, oe-coach, loa-navigator and claims-compass are deterministic React widgets, not model calls. They need component tests, not this pack.
